material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles cover the identical hoarding case: 36 Border Collies removed from Palm City on Aug. 10, now at Humane Society of the Treasure Coast with adoptions opening Sept. 1. The breed education angle is useful context but does not constitute an independently newsworthy follow-up that would merit its own headline for readers already aware of the rescue. This content should update the existing canonical.
